data.body: Closing as not_a_bug (decision, 2026-10-25). The premise, three rebar/host metrics silent for 7+ days, does not hold: they were measured publishing on 2026-09-20 and again on 2026-10-24 04:55 PDT (datapoints in 168 of 168 hours each, read-only CloudWatch). AC1 (why they stopped, and fix it) cannot be answered because the 2026-09 silence was never diagnosed and does not reproduce. AC2 to AC5 ask for a new capability (a datapoint-recency detector, an audit of all rebar/host metrics, a check that fails if it stops running); that is now the task bold-causative-nandoo (022a-02ed-7f80-4515), linked discovered_from this ticket, left unclaimed.
